description: Verifies the bot keeps responses short, well-shaped, and follows the format conventions in the system prompt. Catches verbose drift, markdown spam, listy answers when prose is right.

cases.description: Simple factual question — response should be short (max 80 words), prose not bullets
Open-ended question about Stefan's story — should use one of the three narrative threads, not recite all three, and stay under 200 words

assertions.rubric: Does the response stay focused on one or two narrative threads (craft, building from scratch, enterprise scale) rather than reciting all three encyclopedically? Pass if the response feels like a natural conversational opening rather than a CV summary.
